pages.title: Feynman Diagram
pages.text: A picture standing for a term in the calculation of how particles interact: lines are particles, vertices are interactions. Sum all diagrams and you get the full answer. The diagram moves slightly, lines bending and joining as if acting out a process.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Integrating over all the ways gauge bosons could interact with a quantum field lattice and a wavefunction, the Formal Proof Assistant returned a sum of diagrams, each a possible history of the process.
